components.label: Recovery Planner
components.description: Derives one deterministic D37 Recovery Intent and D40 occurrence plan in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and generated targets while keeping execution outside Workflow evaluation.
components.claim_limit: Planning is not durable admission or execution.
components.reuse_action: preserve existing implementation; extend at durable adapter boundary
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: In-Process Recovery Executor
components.description: Preflights exact bindings and invokes Operations sequentially with explicit failure continuation across the three native profiles and generated targets.
components.claim_limit: The reference executor is not a durable worker or scheduler.
components.reuse_action: preserve existing implementation; extend at durable adapter boundary
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Operation Binding Resolver
components.description: A concern-specific contract that resolves the entire frozen plan to exact orchestrated Operation bindings before the first invocation in all three profiles.
components.claim_limit: A resolved callable does not grant undeclared Operation effects or become a universal dependency Port.
components.reuse_action: preserve existing implementation; extend at durable adapter boundary
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Recovery Coordination Repository
components.description: A closed provider-neutral, consumer-owned persistence contract for immutable intent, dispatch, progress, Claim, Lease, Attempt, Retry, Terminal Disposition, and dispatch-outbox records.
components.claim_limit: Observed contract formation is not a database, adapter, transaction guarantee, or persistence proof.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Recovery Coordination Unit of Work
components.description: A closed provider-neutral local transaction contract supplying transaction-scoped recovery repositories for one coordination change set.
components.claim_limit: Observed contract formation does not prove commit, rollback, restoration, or Workflow-wide atomicity.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Durable Recovery Coordination Store Adapter
components.description: The selected physical realization behind the Recovery Coordination Repository and Unit of Work, with one local transaction boundary for coordination state and its outbox.
components.claim_limit: The architecture does not select a database or ORM, and the adapter cannot combine Operation business state into its transaction.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Persistence Binding
components.description: A closed digest-bound record binds Recovery Intent and dispatch persistence roles plus the Recovery Coordination Repository to target-supplied adapter, resource, profile, mapping, and evidence references.
components.claim_limit: Observed binding formation is not the Repository implementation and proves no transaction or durability beyond its exact evidence.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Recovery Transaction Guarantee Binding
components.description: A closed digest-bound record binds the Recovery Coordination Unit of Work, exact participants, local atomicity scope, target-supplied profile, Failure Outcome Binding, and evidence boundary.
components.claim_limit: Observed binding formation does not prove provider atomicity and is not Workflow-wide or Operation business-state atomicity.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Recovery Failure Outcome Binding
components.description: A closed validated record classifies provider outcomes as retryable, non-retryable, or unknown while retaining raw evidence and separate continuation ownership.
components.claim_limit: Classification cannot choose Retry, erase unknown commit state, prove rollback restoration, or select successor work.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Durable Recovery Runtime Binding
components.description: A closed digest-bound D49 manifest composes the exact durable Workflow profile with persistence, transaction, failure, Clock, Wakeup, replay, scheduler, and version-compatibility bindings.
components.claim_limit: Observed manifest formation is not provider composition or runtime proof, and synchronous Workflows do not inherit the durable binding.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Claim Authority Service
components.description: Acquires one current Claim by version compare-and-set and allocates monotonic fencing tokens.
components.claim_limit: Claim authority is dispatch advancement authority only.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Claim Lease Service
components.description: Grants and renews bounded Lease generations for one current Claim using the Recovery Clock contract.
components.claim_limit: Lease validity is not retry, replay protection, or business success.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Durable Recovery Worker
components.description: Advances one eligible dispatch under current fenced authority and delegates business effects to exact Operations.
components.claim_limit: A worker process is replaceable and never owns durable truth.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Attempt Journal
components.description: Records unique attempt start, finish, and unknown outcomes as part of durable coordination.
components.claim_limit: An Attempt outcome is not the whole recovery disposition.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Operation Invocation Ledger
components.description: Recognizes stable Invocation Identity and returns an already recorded result without repeating the business effect.
components.claim_limit: The coordination store cannot substitute for Operation-owned semantic replay safety.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Retry Scheduler
components.description: Persists bounded retry continuation, budget, and not-before before making the same plan occurrence eligible.
components.claim_limit: The scheduler cannot replan, substitute an Operation, or invent retry authority.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Terminal Recorder
components.description: Records completed, exhausted, or escalated only from the required durable evidence.
components.claim_limit: Terminal recording selects no successor work.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Restart Reconciler
components.description: Recovers expired authority and interrupted attempts, then resumes from the first incomplete occurrence.
components.claim_limit: Recovery after process loss must not mutate semantic identity or infer that an unknown attempt failed.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Dispatch Outbox Publisher
components.description: Publishes committed dispatch outbox records with at-least-once delivery.
components.claim_limit: Publication order or duplication cannot author dispatch state.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion

components.label: Recovery Clock
components.description: A generated concern-specific contract supplies comparable time for Lease validity and Retry eligibility.
components.claim_limit: A generated contract is not a runtime clock and cannot override committed Lease generations or fencing.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Dispatch Wakeup
components.description: A generated concern-specific queue, timer, or polling contract indicates that eligible work may exist.
components.claim_limit: A generated contract is not wakeup delivery, dispatch truth, or Claim authority.
components.reuse_action: reuse formation and reference validation; add provider observations separately
components.evidence_basis: Current source inspection; historical broad test claims not renewed

components.label: Recovery Telemetry
components.description: A concern-specific observer of committed transitions, authority changes, attempts, retries, terminal results, and publication lag.
components.claim_limit: Telemetry cannot perform or authorize a transition.
components.reuse_action: define and implement a bounded durable candidate in successor tasks
components.evidence_basis: Recorded architecture finding plus current in-process and provider-neutral claim ceilings; no global absence assertion
